ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Bu3P: is written in the upper left of the figure, representing tributylphosphine; it points via a curved arrow to Se on the right. The main structure is a benzene ring, with an NO2 substituent attached to the benzene ring, and the right side of the benzene ring is connected to Se; the right side of Se is connected to a group written as CN. The problem requires ignoring arrows and counting only the number of bonds corresponding to single bonds, double bonds, and triple bonds between non-hydrogen atoms in the structure. Reasoning count: Expand Bu3P as tributylphosphine according to the specified method. Each butyl group gives 1 P-C bond and 3 C-C bonds, namely 4 heavy-atom bonds per butyl group; 3 butyl groups total 3 × 4 = 12 bonds. Then count the aryl/nitro/selenocyanate part: the benzene ring is counted as 9 bond units in Kekule form; the benzene ring-N bond is 1; the total N-O bonding in the nitro group is 3; the benzene ring-Se bond is 1; the Se-C bond is 1; the C-N connection written as CN is counted as 1 according to the displayed-structure convention. This fragment totals 9 + 1 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 16. The total is 12 + 16 = 28.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the image, then count by fragments. Expand Bu3P as tributylphosphine: each butyl group contributes one P-C bond plus three C-C bonds, so 3 × 4 = 12 heavy-atom bonds. For the aryl/nitro/selenocyanate fragment, count the benzene Kekule ring as 9 bond units, the ring-N bond as 1, the nitro N-O bonding as 3, the ring-Se bond as 1, the Se-C bond as 1, and the C-N bond in the written CN group as 1 under the displayed-structure convention. Add the fragment subtotals: 12 + 16 = 28.

推理计数：按指定方法把 Bu3P 展开为 tributylphosphine。每个丁基给出 1 个 P-C 键和 3 个 C-C 键，即每个丁基 4 个重原子键；3 个丁基合计 3 × 4 = 12 个键。然后统计芳基/硝基/硒氰酸酯部分：苯环按 Kekule 形式计为 9 个键单位；苯环-N 键为 1；硝基中 N-O 键合总计为 3；苯环-Se 键为 1；Se-C 键为 1；写作 CN 的 C-N 连接按显示结构约定计为 1。该片段合计 9 + 1 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 16。总数为 12 + 16 = 28。
